title: The optimal universal exponential base for Euclidean kissing numbers
summary: For every positive integer n, the Euclidean kissing number tau_n is an attained maximum and satisfies tau_n = sqrt(6), and the supremum of tau_n^(1/n) over positive dimensions equals sqrt(6). No asymptotic-optimality claim is made.

formalizes.title: A Universal Square-Root-of-Six Bound for Kissing Numbers

review.reason: Establishes exact kissing number values and the optimal universal exponential base in all dimensions.
